baseAlert.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} whose creation prompted the generation of this similarity score.

comparableAlert.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert} being compared against the base alert.

similarityScore.description:
A numeric score representing the extent of similarity for the two {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s.
For the base app, this will be a number between 0 and 1 inclusive.

displaySimilarity.description:
Value of any type representing similarity for the two {@link ReliabilityAssetAlert}s.
It can be a numeric percentage, a categorical string (e.g., High, Medium, Low), or another type of value
This value will be showed in the UI.

For the base app, this will be the similarityScore * 100.

name: ReliabilityAssetAlertSimilarity
